We don't have any special natural talent for this. Just like everyone else, we put our hours in. I usually have a guitar in my hands for two hours per day. She often has twice as many - though she's been a bit slack lately and only putting in a couple of hours per day.

We do this every day, even on days we really don't want to. We don't just play songs, we diligently practice and study. We do this every single day. We don't take weekends off. We don't take holidays off. We do this every day.

Well, in a 30 day month, we might actually take it easy two or three days. For those days, we will still play but we won't be diligently practicing. We often put in more than our scheduled amount of time.

That's why we can play these things.

It's also why I tell people to 'put your hours in.' There's no shortcut to skillful playing.
